facts.fact: The article reports the Access to Information Act, Cap 95 (ATIA), as the law giving a right of access under its section 4, applied by the High Court in a judgment of 7 August 2026; the article gives no year of enactment, so the judgment date is used.
facts.system: The Access to Information Act, Cap 95

facts.fact: The High Court of Uganda (Civil Division) on 7 August 2026 allowed UNEB's appeal against a Chief Magistrates Court order, made on a complaint against an information officer's decision under the ATIA, that had compelled release of a candidate's examination scripts, and set aside UGX 12,000,000 damages.
facts.system: The Access to Information Act, Cap 95
